verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Garments of praise
Fullness of joy
Unending mercy
New every morning

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Then I saw my ashes, but You saw Your dream
And I saw an orphan, You were my family
And I saw my frailty, but You saw Your might
And I saw my blindness, but You were the light

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Well I saw the water, but You saw the wine
I saw dead branches, but You were the vine
And I saw my weakness, but You saw Your blood
I saw my failure, but You were enough

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
I was lost, 'til You called me out by Name
And I was down, 'til You picked me up again
I was wrong, 'til Your love it made me right
I was dead, 'til You sang me back to life
